message.speaker: Keith Tyser
message.suppliedBy: Mark Barney, publisher of The ARC Daily Digest
message.text: Haha thanks! Love the Daily Digest idea btw. Such a fun way to keep up with the competition. Saw you guys made a big jump too! I think I’ve finally found the secret sauce, and it seems to work for both ARC 2 and 3 👀
message.provenance: Transcript supplied by the publisher in this chat. Publisher explicitly requested publication in a special late edition and on X. The original message was not independently reopened by the desk.

ARC Prize (@arcprize) posted on October 9: ARC Prize announced a new 2026 ARC-AGI-2 Kaggle high of 88.06% by Tufa Labs and said a $150,000 bonus would be split among teams scoring above 85%.

Tufa Labs (@tufalabs) posted on October 10: In a reply to Mike Knoop’s ARC-AGI-2 bonus-threshold post, Tufa Labs said it had not set out to solve ARC-AGI-2, started by accident, and plans to share more after the deadline. This is the team’s account, not an independently established history.

Jean-François Puget (@JFPuget) posted on October 9: Puget asked ARC Prize whether the 85% bonus threshold refers to the public or private leaderboard; no organizer answer was visible in the checked thread.

Mike Knoop (@mikeknoop) posted on October 9: Knoop said ARC-AGI-2 remains much harder than ARC-AGI-1 and that eventual open solutions will be useful to study, while quoting his earlier reaction to Tufa Labs crossing the public Kaggle bonus threshold.
Mike Knoop (@mikeknoop) posted on October 9: Knoop said the 85% Grand Prize bonus threshold had been reached on Kaggle and called 2026 the final ARC-AGI-2 Kaggle year.
François Chollet (@fchollet) posted on October 9: Chollet reacted to ARC Prize’s Tufa Labs ARC-2 announcement by saying Kaggle scores are getting very good.
ARC Prize (@arcprize) posted on October 9: ARC Prize announced Stephen Wolfram as a keynote speaker for its 2026 Research Summit.
Jack Cole (@MindsAI_Jack) posted on October 9: Cole congratulated Tufa Labs on the ARC-2 result, calling it a momentous achievement.
Greg Kamradt (@GregKamradt) posted on October 9: Kamradt said he was excited Wolfram would join the ARC Prize Summit in two weeks, quoting the organizer’s announcement.
